title: Made runtime interventions traceable across lanes and analyst answers
points: Lane submit vetoes and fallback evidence insertion now emit structured runtime-intervention records instead of only free-text retry errors.
Analyst answer cleanup passes now record whether they changed the answer, with before/after snippets and failure-bucket metadata.
Internal eval traces can now bucket failures as prompt fact, prompt instruction, runtime, corpus, or provider issues without changing the user-facing trace UI.
